Can you clear the mines and take your factory to the sky?

small bug fixes

Controls:
[ ] means controller
Q/E [RT/LT] - Hooks
WASD [Left Analog Stick] - Air and Ground movement
Space [LB] - Gas Boost
R [RB] - Reload blades
X [Dpad down] - Flare
P [Dpad right] - Back to menu
H [Dpad left] - Spawn or Ride your horse
[RT] - Interact with gas supply
